- **Privilege escalation vector** — Trojanized compilers are a well-known persistence mechanism
- **Affects all users** — Any developer or build process using `gcc` would be impacted

### This mirrors the famous Ken Thompson hack:
> *"You can't trust code that you did not totally create yourself."* — Ken Thompson, 1984 Turing Award Lecture
